pointers.sentence: `pgettext_lazy`, `ngettext_lazy` and `npgettext_lazy` make the same kind of object for a message with a context or a plural, and the plural ones can wait for their number as well (`django/utils/translation/__init__.py:lazy_number`).

With `USE_I18N` on, before the application registry is ready it cannot translate at all: making the translations of `LANGUAGE_CODE` asks the registry for the installed applications, and raises `AppRegistryNotReady`, whose message asks the reader to check for non-lazy gettext calls at import time ([Message catalogues: `DjangoTranslation`](catalogues.md)) (`django/utils/translation/trans_real.py:DjangoTranslation._add_installed_apps_translations`).

`gettext_lazy` is `lazy(gettext, str)` and `pgettext_lazy` is `lazy(pgettext, str)`, each wrapping the facade's function, which is itself bound to its implementation only when first called ([Translating a message](translating.md)) (`django/utils/translation/__init__.py:gettext_lazy`).

Its class, made by `lazy`, has the methods of `str`, the comparisons, the hash and the operators among them, and each first calls the function with the kept arguments, then acts on the string it got (`django/utils/functional.py:lazy`).
`django.utils.translation.ngettext_lazy` and `npgettext_lazy` pass their arguments to `lazy_number`, which looks at the number (`django/utils/translation/__init__.py:lazy_number`).
For that, `lazy_number` makes a subclass of `str` inside itself, and a proxy whose function returns an empty instance of it (`django/utils/translation/__init__.py:lazy_number.NumberAwareString`).
A proxy is pickled as its function and its arguments (`django/utils/functional.py:lazy.__proxy__.__reduce__`).

This one's function is a lambda made inside `lazy_number`, and pickle refuses a local object; so `lazy_number` gives the proxy a `__reduce__` of its own, which names `_lazy_number_unpickle` and the original arguments, and unpickling calls `lazy_number` again (`django/utils/translation/__init__.py:_lazy_number_unpickle`).

A template writes each value through `render_value_in_context`: the conversion to the current time zone and `localize` leave a lazy translation as it is, and, being no `str`, it is made one, and escaped where autoescaping is on, as the template renders ([Rendering: nodes and the render context](../templates/rendering.md)) (`django/template/base.py:render_value_in_context`).

`django.utils.text.format_lazy` is `lazy` of a call of `str.format`: its format string and its arguments may be lazy translations, and all are translated when the result is made a string (`django/utils/text.py:format_lazy`).

`serializer_factory` makes a `Promise` its string ([Serializing values: `serializer_factory` and `deconstruct`](../makemigrations/serializer.md)) (`django/db/migrations/serializer.py:serializer_factory`), and makemigrations runs under `no_translations`, which calls `django.utils.translation.deactivate_all`: the active translation is then a `gettext.NullTranslations`, which gives each message back as it is, the use its docstring names ([Running a command: `BaseCommand`](../commands/running.md)) (`django/utils/translation/trans_real.py:deactivate_all`).

`serializer_factory` makes a `Promise` its string ([Serializing values: `serializer_factory` and `deconstruct`](../makemigrations/serializer.md)) (`django/db/migrations/serializer.py:serializer_factory`), and makemigrations runs under `no_translations`, which calls `django.utils.translation.deactivate_all`: the active translation is then a `gettext.NullTranslations`, which gives each message back as it is, the use its docstring names ([Running a command: `BaseCommand`](../commands/running.md)) (`django/utils/translation/trans_real.py:deactivate_all`).

`get_format_lazy` is `lazy(get_format, str, list, tuple)`, a format of the locale read when it is used ([Locale formats: `get_format` and the format modules](formats.md)) (`django/utils/formats.py:get_format_lazy`).

The names of the days and the months in `django/utils/dates.py` are lazy translations made at import, so one dictionary serves every language ([Writing numbers, dates and durations](writing-values.md)).

`conditional_escape` is one of the places in Django that test for `Promise` and make a string of it (`django/utils/html.py:conditional_escape`); code that tests only for `str` should be given `str` of it.
